Class TelemetryEvaluationResult

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.telemetry.TelemetryEvaluationResult
public final class TelemetryEvaluationResult extends Object
Immutable evaluation output produced by CompiledTelemetryPlan for a live tick or an offline saved snapshot.

1.0.0-beta.3
